brief:
A funeral was held for 75 Palestinians whose remains were recovered from the ruins across Gaza, Al Jazeera English reported. The Health Ministry said most of the victims were from the Daraj neighbourhood in Gaza City.

The recovery and burial marked efforts to identify and lay to rest Palestinians killed in the conflict whose bodies had been trapped beneath collapsed buildings.
dek: Most of the victims were from the Daraj neighbourhood in Gaza City, the Health Ministry says.
title: Gaza recovers 75 Palestinian remains from war rubble for burial
